tools.name: codeatlas_list_services
tools.description: List every CodeAtlas service with slug, description, capabilities, delivery timeline and canonical URL.

tools.name: codeatlas_get_service
tools.description: Return one CodeAtlas service by its stable slug: produto-digital, zelvo-ai or consultoria.

tools.name: codeatlas_search_services
tools.description: Search CodeAtlas services by business challenge or capability, in Portuguese or English. An empty query returns all services.

tools.name: codeatlas_request_contact
tools.description: Submit a first-conversation request to CodeAtlas on behalf of a person. Sends an email to the CodeAtlas team. Requires an OAuth Bearer token with scope api:write (see https://codeatlas.com.br/auth.md). Only call this after the person asked you to contact CodeAtlas and gave you their name and email.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "codeatlas_request_contact" references sensitive artifacts (bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Submit a first-conversation request to CodeAtlas on behalf of a person. Sends an email to the CodeAtlas team. Requires an OAuth Bearer token with scope api:writ…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: codeatlas_list_services · Private data: codeatlas_request_contact · Public sink: codeatlas_request_contact.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: codeatlas_list_services · Private data: codeatlas_request_contact · Public sink: codeatlas_request_contact

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
